warranty.lede: MyStore provides a 1-year warranty on all devices.
warranty.title: Warranty terms
terms: The warranty covers manufacturing defects in the product and faults of a manufacturing nature that arise during the warranty period.
The warranty period begins on the date the product is handed over to the buyer.

The warranty does not cover defects or damage that arise after the product is handed over to the buyer as a result of improper use, failure to follow storage requirements, mechanical damage, liquid entering the product, intervention by third parties, or force majeure.
For warranty service, the buyer must contact MyStore and present the product and proof of purchase.
Where necessary, whether a fault qualifies for warranty coverage is determined by inspecting or technically testing the product.

Warranty service may take up to 40 working days, depending on the nature of the fault, the diagnostics required, and the availability of spare parts, while complying with the requirements of the legislation of the Republic of Armenia.

If the product fails to conform during the warranty period, the consumer is entitled to the remedies provided by law free of charge. This warranty does not limit the consumer’s rights under the legislation of the Republic of Armenia.
warranty.voltage: The warranty also does not cover damage caused by electrical voltage fluctuations.
warranty.cardRequired: A warranty card is required for a warranty claim.

returns.title: Returns
returns.lede: Returns and exchanges are handled in accordance with Armenian law. Goods of satisfactory quality may be returned or exchanged within 14 days of receipt.
terms: The product must be unused, with its original appearance and consumer properties preserved and its seals and labels intact.
Bring the product, a payment document and evidence of purchase from MyStore.
For a return by delivery service, the deadline is met if the product is handed to a postal, courier or other delivery service within 14 days of receipt.
Exceptions for non-returnable goods provided by law apply.
returns.rights: These conditions apply to goods of satisfactory quality and do not limit the customer’s statutory rights regarding defective goods.
returns.law: Armenian Law on Consumer Rights Protection, Article 23
